sentences.text: 1 petitioner in case FIR No. 0065 dated 02.02.2024 registered under Sections 120 120-B, B, 406 and 420 IPC at Police Station City Palwal, District Palwal, Haryana.
Brief facts as per the prosecution are that the petitioner along with the co-accused co accused had cheated the complainant for Rs. 85,00,000/ on the pretext of selling scrap.

Hence the present 85,00,000/-
GURPREET FIR.
authenticity of this document.
Learned counsel for the petitioner contends that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The present FIR is a counter-blast counter blast to the FIR filed by the brother of the petitioner against the complainant only to exert pressure to compromise the matter.
He submits that only vague allegations have been imputed on the petitioner that he took Rs. 09 Lakh in cash from the complainant and there is no nothing thing to substantiate the same.
He further submits that the petitioner is neither the middleman nor the witness to the transaction.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the co co-accused accused Harman and Rajeev Sharda have already been granted concession of bail by the trial Court vide order dated 04.10.2025.
Learned counsel has further submitted that the petitioner is ready and willing to join the investigation as and when called upon to do so by the investigating agency.
Reply by way of an affidavit of Narender Singh, H.P.S., Deputy Superintendent of Police, Sadar Palwal, District Palwal has been filed by learned State counsel, which is taken on record.

Learned State counsel while referring to the status report, has opposed the prayer for grant of antici anticipatory patory bail, by submitting that the allegations levelled against the petitioner are serious in nature.
He further submitted that the petitioner along with co-accused co accused hatched conspiracy against the complainant by duping for huge amount of money of Rs. 85 la lacs.
Mr. Arvind Seth, Advocate has put in appearance on behalf of the complainant and has filed his vakalatnama in Court today, which is taken on record.

He while opposing the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail to the petitioner, has contended that the petitioner petitioner has played an active role in the crime and, thus, does not deserve the concession of bail.
